{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check for invalid age values (i.e., not -1 and not numeric)
invalid_age_mask = (sales_df_clean['customer_age'] == -1) | (sales_df_clean['customer_age'] < 0)
print("Invalid age rows:", sales_df_clean[invalid_age_mask])

# Since the only invalid value is -1, as per the dictionary, we can safely exclude it
# Compute mean age, excluding -1
mean_age = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
